notes.title: Monmusu Paradise ~ Visitor ~ Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello, Guys!!!
We’re excited to announce that the Monmusu Paradise ~ Visitor ~ demo is officially LIVE! 🎉

The demo is available for everyone to try, but Supporters will get 2 weeks of early access to the full game before the official release! 🥳

What’s in the Demo?
🎣 Fishing Minigame: Relax and catch some surprises!

🏝️ Cozy Resort Music: Chill out with soothing vibes while you explore.

👀 Meet the Heroines, and unlock 3 of 9 scenes we have prepared for you guys!
Get a glimpse of the personalities and designs you’ll encounter in the full game.

How to Play:

Supporters get 2 weeks of early access to the full game soon!
Visit our social media for more information!
[url=https://x.com/silumansoft]https://x.com/silumansoft
[/url]
The demo is available for everyone to try starting NOW!
But the full game will be available to the public after 2 weeks of early access for supporters.

Why Play the Demo?
We want your feedback! Your thoughts on gameplay, mechanics, and characters will help us refine and improve the final release. We’d love to hear what you think!

Stay Tuned!
Thank you so much for your support! We’re excited to share the full game with you all in a couple of weeks. Until then, enjoy the demo and let us know your thoughts! 💖

PS: Don't forget that we have the ongoing campaign to add more content for free!!!
Wishlist the game now so we can reach that target!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3406800/Monmusu_Paradise_Visitors/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3406800/Monmusu_Paradise_Visitors/[/url]

notes.title: Thank you for buying Siluman Royal Bundle DLC.(How to read them)
notes.content:
Thank you for buying Siluman Royal Bundle DLC!
The DLC is a collection of Siluman Novels and Artbooks throughout the year.
To read them you can open their folder directly using these steps.

A. Use Steam Folder Finder.
1. Right click on the Siluman Fantasy Game and select Properties.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34234828/566ff29fa475bcb6cb9580803574b56e344f8269.png[/img]
2. Select the top third tab, Local Files and select "BROWSE LOCAL FILES"
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34234828/41b014dfa088113afa89dd5e459ce911b6618f25.png[/img]
3. Voila, you can select the books in the separate folder there.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34234828/958803a7f1560dd1cce95c0c626df8794568254d.png[/img]
4. Please do read them in a room separate from your family to enjoy your private time. ːsteamhappyː

B. Directly in the folder
1. Type "\steamapps\common\Siluman Fantasy\" from the folder you installed steam. it will take you to the game folder directly.
2. Enjoy your monster girls artbooks :D

notes.title: Happy on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello and thank you for visiting us! 

We are Siluman-Soft and this is actually out first game, who releases on a big platform like steam. It´s an honor for us, to be now a part of this Community. 
At the moment, we are waiting for steam, to approve our release-schedule. So, let us talk a bit about us!

We are a small team of 2 people and we started this Project 3 years ago. 
The first step in our work is, designing a monster Girl! Then working on the fitting story/gameplay for her and many other Aspects. 
We thought about many ways, for a fun-gameplay, like: RPG, shooter or an action game. But in the end, we decided to stay more classic.
Because everything else, would have needed way more investment in Workforce, that we don´t have.

We love to make games. So, we decided, to start small and grow big! I Hope, you join us on our journey…

And this journey, starts here with our very first Steam release.
Thank you for your time and support!

Silumansoft.
